question:
Which of the following statements is correct regarding the parts of Indian constitution?

I. Part VIII is related with the Union territories.

II. Part IX is related with the Co-Operative Societies.
solution:
The correct answer is __**3**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
 
 
• **Part VIII** of the Indian Constitution deals with **Union Territories**. It includes Articles **239 to 242**, which provide the framework for the administration of Union Territories. ***Hence, Statement I is correct.*** 
 
• **Part IX** of the Indian Constitution is dedicated to the **Panchayati Raj system**. It includes Articles **243 to 243-O** and primarily focuses on the governance of rural areas through local self-government institutions like Panchayats. ***Hence, Statement II is incorrect.*** 
 
• **Part IX-B**, inserted through the **97th Constitutional Amendment Act (2011)**, specifically deals with **Co-operative Societies**. It includes Articles **243-ZH to 243-ZT**. Therefore, the reference to Part IX for Co-operative Societies in the question is misplaced. ***Hence, Statement II is incorrect.***
